svg.title: SGLA自身历史搜索状态选择：初始论文方法框架
svg.desc: Solid teal arrows show the response-selection route. Amber dashed boxes show the tested learned-scoring alternative. Each crop is processed separately by the same fixed SGLA-based tracker E: six prefix blocks and one independent candidate. Only accepted past predictions enter history. Future images and ground truth are used only for offline scorer labels.
